product.name: Bluetooth Thermal Label Maker
product.description: A rechargeable phone-connected printer for small black-and-white thermal labels.

script_facts: The label maker prints small black-and-white labels using direct thermal paper instead of an ink cartridge.
A companion phone app is required to design and send a label over Bluetooth.
The printer is rechargeable and charges over USB-C.
Compatible thermal label rolls are consumable supplies.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim color printing or operation without the companion app.
Do not claim that every label size or third-party roll is compatible.
Do not claim waterproof, fade-proof, archival, or shipping-label performance.
Do not claim free templates or permanent savings.
editorial_direction: Lead with a label appearing without an ink cartridge.
Explain the required phone-app and Bluetooth step rather than hiding it.
Use drawers, cables, or containers only as examples of small-label organization.
Mention thermal label rolls as a consumable limitation if discussing the lack of ink.
Do not mention a brand, price, rating, or affiliate details.
